title: Moderate deviations of suprema of Gaussian processes A cyclic approximation criterion
comment: Extended Introduction, with new related results. Some parts of the text revised and improved. (29 pages)
abstract: We study moderate deviations of suprema of parametrized sequences of sample bounded Gaussian processes $\{X _x(t), t\in T _x\}$, and first present recent sharp bounds in simple cases. In the almost periodic case, we prove an approximation theorem. We introduce a modulable diophantine approximation. Finally we study for general non-vanishing coefficient sequences, the behavior along lattices of almost periodic Gaussian polynomials with linearly independent frequencies, and use a lattice localized version of Kronecker's theorem.
